audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts are flat 'Skill' for six of seven stages, while the whys on those same rows say Garen leads levels 1-5 and Ambessa takes over at 6. The packet chart is Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Ambessa/Skill/Ambessa and Garen wins 53.68% over 2552 games.
audit.why: A chart that says 'Skill' on every row tells the reader nothing and directly contradicts the text beside it, which names concrete early leads and a hard level-6 flip.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one group in both layers: Garen levels 1 through 4-5, Ambessa at 6, skill check at first item, Ambessa at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike calls Public Execution an 'engage/execute' and gives no cooldown. Riot's text has no execute: she blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing, suppresses on arrival, then slams them for damage and a stun. It is 130/115/100 seconds.
audit.why: 'Farthest champion in a line' is actionable positioning advice — standing behind your own minions or an ally changes who she can take. 'Execute' is an invented threshold that makes a reader play their health bar wrong.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now state the line-and-farthest-target targeting, the suppression-then-stun sequence and the 130s rank-1 cooldown, with the positioning rule that follows from it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect list says this matchup never names a single Ambessa ability. Three real interactions went unstated: Cunning Sweep transforms into Sundering Slam only after it strikes an enemy, so the silence window matters; Repudiation braces and deals INCREASED damage if it blocked non-minion damage while bracing, so spinning into the brace feeds it; and Drakehound's Step dashes on the cast with an empowered next attack, so the wind-up is the tell, not the ability.
audit.why: All three are in Riot's own descriptions and all three change what the player does in the next two seconds. The missing-interactions feed flagged the shield and the auto-reset independently.
audit.corrected: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam named in whys[2], spikes[0] and wants.you[1]; Repudiation's blocked-damage amplification stated in spikes[0] and wants.foe[0]; Drakehound's Step named as the step-back tell in early; Lacerate and its 13s rank-1 cooldown in whys[3] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] rushes Executioner's Calling because 'his healing breaks your trade math', and calls Mortal Reminder a priority because 'his healing fights your execute'. Nothing in Riot's description of any Ambessa ability heals her.
audit.why: The kit file carries a heal flag on Public Execution, but Riot's text for it is blink, suppress, slam, damage, stun — no healing. Per the standing rule, the description wins over a derived flag, so this reads as a tooltip-parse misfire and the item priority built on it is wrong.
audit.corrected: Not rewritten — report[8] is far outside the band for any honest replacement and the correct build order is a call for the user. Flagged in notes and questionsForUser.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json R text vs its heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is scraped source text: winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[1].t and report[3].t all contain 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 104' and a chart pasted into prose. focus.text is 'Ambessa dash fluidity and ultimate suppression' and report[5]/[9]/[10]/[12] track a non-existent ability called 'Repeating Dashes'.
audit.why: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. Her mobility is Drakehound's Step (P), and the tracked cooldown should be Public Execution (130s) or Repudiation (18s).
audit.corrected: Not repaired here — none of these fit inside the +/-10% band. Flagged for a structural pass.

notes: Two things left deliberately untouched. (1) The anti-heal build advice in report[8] rests on a heal flag on Public Execution that Riot's own description does not support — see audit point 10; I did not delete it because the correct replacement item order is the user's call. (2) The mirror (ambessa__garen) flagged an unverified claim repeated four times that suppression ignores Courage's tenacity and only the closing stun is shortened. Nothing in the kit data settles that, so I left every tenacity line alone on this side too, including wants.you[2]. The packet defect 'never names any of Ambessa's abilities' is now addressed in the content layer: Cunning Sweep, Sundering Slam, Repudiation, Lacerate, Drakehound's Step and Public Execution all appear with real cooldowns. The full layer still names a non-existent ability, 'Repeating Dashes', in five fields.
